concerns.text: The plan schedules training of a linear classifier for **30 random seeds** (≈ 30 h total sequentially) but asserts the entire pipeline will finish within the 6‑hour free‑tier CI wall‑clock limit by “batching seeds”. The free‑tier GitHub Actions runner provides only 2 CPU cores, making such parallel batching infeasible; consequently the compute budget is unrealistic and the pipeline will exceed the allowed runtime.
